title: Frontend: Todos tab — list, create, check/uncheck, reorder, mark urgent
description: Build the Todos tab with a sortable, filterable todo list with inline creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Checkbox toggles completion — updates progress bar in real time
Urgent todos shown with a warning/fire icon
Filter by: all, active, completed, urgent
Points change shown as a brief toast on completion

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/TodosTab.tsx. Similar drag-and-drop pattern to milestones using @dnd-kit/sortable. State: filter ('all'|'active'|'completed'|'urgent'). Filter tabs at top.

Create src/components/project/TodoItem.tsx. Drag handle, checkbox (toggles is_completed), title, urgent badge (if is_urgent), due date. On completion toggle: call PATCH API, show toast '+10 pts' or '-10 pts'. Long-press or hover → show delete button.
Input at bottom of list. Enter to submit. Optional: due date picker and urgent toggle before creating. POST /api/projects/:id/todos.
Add 5 todos. Check one — verify progress bar updates, toast shows +10 pts. Filter by 'active' — verify completed hidden. Drag to reorder — verify order persists after reload.
